description: This file contains an Android ListActivity implementation that displays a list with separators, including a custom adapter class MyListAdapter that manages the list items and their enabled states based on their content.

classes.name: List5
classes.description: Main activity extending ListActivity that sets a custom adapter for displaying a list of cheese names with separators.

classes.name: MyListAdapter
classes.description: Inner class extending BaseAdapter that provides data and views for the List5 activity, managing enabled state based on whether items start with a hyphen.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the list adapter.

methods.name: MyListAdapter<init>
methods.description: Constructor that takes the context and initializes the adapter.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the list.

methods.name: areAllItemsEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether all items are enabled, returns false to allow per-item enable/disable.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Determines if a specific item is enabled based on whether it starts with a hyphen.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the position as a placeholder for the item object.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as the item ID.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Provides a TextView for each list item, inflating layout if necessary and setting text.
